Variable selection for MutualForestImpact.

Source: R/MutualForestImpact.R
MutualForestImpactVariableSelection.Rd

Variable selection for MutualForestImpact.

Usage

MutualForestImpactVariableSelection(
  MFI,
  variables,
  candidates,
  p.threshold = 0.01,
  method = c("Janitza", "Permutation")
)

Arguments

MFI

MutualForestImpact() object.

variables

Vector of variable names for which related variables should be searched.

candidates

Vector of variable names that are candidates to be related to the variables.

p.threshold

(Default = 0.01) P-value threshold

method

The method to use. One of: "Janitza" or "Permutation".

Value

A list:

  • method: The method used.

  • selected: A list of vectors containing selected candidates for each investigated variable.

  • p.values: A list of numeric vectors containing p-values for each candidate's relation to each investigated variable.
